about: Product words for every feature in AC Admin's Feature catalogue. The code decides status: scripts/catalogue/build_feature_catalogue.py checks each feature's anchors in the workbench and in every release on main, then writes apps/admin-web/app/catalogue/catalogue.generated.json. Edit words here; never type a status or version by hand except 'planned'.
